topic: Peregrine falcon: the fastest animal on Earth, diving at over 300 km/h to catch prey in the air.

episode.title: Peregrine Falcon: Earth's Fastest Animal!

shots.narration: Did you know Earth's fastest animal wears feathers?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated mountain overlook beneath a wide blue sky; a realistic peregrine falcon overhead.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the peregrine falcon.
shots.mood: Sunny wonder, wide eyes, bright natural colours.

shots.narration: Meet the peregrine falcon, a true sky superstar!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic cute peregrine falcon above sunlit mountain cliffs, slate-grey back and dark cheek markings.
shots.action: The peregrine falcon glides across the sky.
shots.mood: Majestic and inviting, warm sunlight on detailed feathers.

shots.narration: [excited] Its dives can reach over 300 km/h!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, grassy mountain overlook, Kiko with green safari hat and binoculars, emerald Pip beside him.
shots.action: Kiko raises his binoculars toward the sky.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, mountain overlook beneath an apparently empty sky, Kiko holding binoculars to his eyes.
shots.action: Kiko sweeps his binoculars across the sky.
shots.mood: Gentle puzzlement, raised eyebrows, sunny and safe.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, peregrine falcon high above rugged sunlit cliffs, soft clouds far behind.
shots.mood: Exciting discovery, crisp feather detail against blue sky.

shots.narration: [surprised] It folds its wings and plunges through the sky!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open mountain sky with distant cliffs, realistic peregrine falcon in a steep dive.
shots.action: The peregrine falcon dives with its wings tucked close.
shots.mood: Thrilling speed, softly blurred background, no danger or impact.

shots.narration: Peregrines catch prey in the air.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear sky above a broad mountain valley, peregrine falcon alone with no prey visible.
shots.action: The peregrine falcon spreads its wings to level out.
shots.mood: Graceful control, bright sunlight, gentle wildlife discovery.

shots.narration: That diving speed makes it Earth's fastest animal!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny mountain overlook, Kiko and Pip beneath the peregrine falcon's distant silhouette.
shots.action: Kiko throws his arms upward in celebration.
shots.mood: Joyful payoff, delighted faces, expansive mountain scenery.

shots.narration: [excited] Can you guess our next animal: a spotted land sprinter?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Kiko and Pip on a sunlit mountain path overlooking distant golden grasslands, no other animals visible.
shots.action: Kiko cups one hand behind his ear toward the viewer.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity, inviting smile, warm adventurous colours.

episode.endHook: Can you guess our next animal: a spotted land sprinter?
episode.description: Join Kiko and Pip as they discover the peregrine falcon’s incredible diving superpower. This speedy bird can dive at over 300 km/h and catch prey in the air!
